faq.heading: Common questions
faq.intro: Quick answers — call or text Kelsey for anything specific to your home.

items.q: Do I need to be home during the clean?
items.a: Not necessarily. Many clients provide a door code or key after the first visit. We'll confirm access and security preferences upfront.

items.q: Do you bring supplies and equipment?
items.a: Yes — professional-grade products and vacuums. If you prefer green products or have sensitivities, tell us and we'll match your preferences.

items.q: How long does a typical visit take?
items.a: Maintenance cleans usually run 2–4 hours depending on home size and condition. Deep cleans and move-outs can take a full day — we'll estimate at the walk-through.
Yes — Maid & Marble is licensed and insured in Massachusetts. Certificate available on request for landlords and property managers.
48 hours notice to reschedule without fee. Same-day cancellations may incur a trip charge — we keep it fair and communicate clearly.

items.q: Do you offer a satisfaction guarantee?
items.a: If something isn't right, tell us within 24 hours and we'll make it right on the next visit or return for a targeted fix when scheduling allows.

items.q: Can I get the same cleaner every time?
items.a: Owner-led service means consistent standards. For recurring plans we prioritize the same team when possible.

items.q: Do you clean homes with pets?
items.a: Absolutely — we love pets. Let us know about shedding or special areas; a pet-hair detail add-on may apply for heavy buildup.

about.heading: Led by Kelsey O'Brien
body: Maid & Marble was built for homeowners who want more than a quick wipe-down — meticulous care, reliable scheduling, and a team that treats your home with respect.
Kelsey works directly with every client: walk-through, clear scope, and follow-through. Licensed and insured across Central Massachusetts.
We serve busy families, professionals working from home, new homeowners, and property managers who need a partner — not a franchise call center.
